title: Zscaler External Attack Surface Management (EASM) Logs

blocks.text: For Zscaler External Attack Surface Management (EASM), logs are defined as public internet-facing assets that are discovered and scanned by Zscaler EASM to identify and analyze potential external attack surfaces. These public internet-facing corporate assets include:

Zscaler retains log information for a rolling period of 14 days during the term of the subscription. When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler after the 14-day retention cycle or earlier upon request.
Logs are stored in the United States.
